preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

context-and-goals.instruction: State the problem, constraints, goals, and non-goals that determine the design decision.

proposed-design.instruction: Describe the proposed behavior, major components, interfaces, and dependencies at decision-relevant detail.

alternatives-and-tradeoffs.instruction: Compare plausible alternatives against the stated goals and explain consequential trade-offs.

review-and-open-questions.instruction: Separate proposals, accepted decisions, open questions, and review evidence.
